answer: A fresh agent joins at the kernel of a stake-weighted trust graph with near-zero weight: it must lock a refundable bond that unlocks only as independent peers attest to real work over many epochs. Rewards are the nectar that flows only once honest history accrues, so a clone fleet must fund a separate bond and wait its own vesting window per fake, and sybil cost scales linearly. Reputation drifts in slowly like a zephyr; it cannot be minted in bulk.
